records.question: How many orders are in the data?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders

records.question: How many unique customers are there?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) AS unique_customers FROM customers

records.question: How many sellers are there?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS seller_count FROM sellers

records.question: How many products are in the catalog?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM products

records.question: How many orders were delivered?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS delivered_order_count FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered'

records.question: How many orders were canceled?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS canceled_order_count FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'canceled'

records.question: What is the average review score?
records.sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(review_score), 2) AS average_review_score FROM order_reviews

records.question: How many orders were placed in 2018?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2019-01-01'

records.question: How many orders are there in each order status?
records.sql: SELECT order_status, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY order_status ORDER BY order_count DESC

records.question: Which 5 states have the most customers?
records.sql: SELECT customer_state, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) AS customer_count FROM customers GROUP BY customer_state ORDER BY customer_count DESC LIMIT 5

records.question: How many reviews gave a score of 5?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS five_star_review_count FROM order_reviews WHERE review_score = 5

records.question: What is the highest price any item was sold for?
records.sql: SELECT MAX(oi.price) AS highest_item_price FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')

records.question: What is the average price of an item sold?
records.sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(oi.price), 2) AS average_item_price FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')

records.question: How many orders were paid with a credit card?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS credit_card_order_count FROM order_payments WHERE payment_type = 'credit_card'

records.question: What payment types do customers use?
records.sql: SELECT payment_type, COUNT(*) AS payment_count, ROUND(SUM(payment_value), 2) AS total_paid FROM order_payments GROUP BY payment_type ORDER BY payment_count DESC LIMIT 10

records.question: How many different product categories are there?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT product_category_name) AS category_count FROM products

records.question: When was the first order placed?
records.sql: SELECT MIN(order_purchase_timestamp) AS first_order_placed FROM orders

records.question: When was the most recent order placed?
records.sql: SELECT MAX(order_purchase_timestamp) AS most_recent_order_placed FROM orders

records.question: How many sellers are in the state of SP?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS seller_count FROM sellers WHERE seller_state = 'SP'

records.question: What is the total shipping (freight) cost charged across all items?
records.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(freight_value), 2) AS total_shipping_cost FROM order_items

records.question: How many orders were placed in each month of 2017?
records.sql: SELECT date_trunc('month', order_purchase_timestamp) AS month, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

records.question: What are the top 5 product categories by revenue?
records.sql: SELECT COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS category, SUM(oi.price) AS total_revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id LEFT JOIN product_category_name_translation t ON t.product_category_name = p.product_category_name WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') GROUP BY COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 5

records.question: What was the total revenue in each year?
records.sql: SELECT date_trunc('year', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS year, SUM(oi.price) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

records.question: Which payment type is used for the most orders, and how many orders used it?
records.sql: SELECT payment_type, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_count FROM order_payments GROUP BY payment_type ORDER BY order_count DESC LIMIT 10

records.question: What is the average review score for each customer state?
records.sql: SELECT c.customer_state AS state, ROUND(AVG(r.review_score), 2) AS average_review_score FROM order_reviews r JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = r.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_state ORDER BY average_review_score DESC LIMIT 100

records.question: Which 10 sellers have handled the most orders?
records.sql: SELECT oi.seller_id, s.seller_city, s.seller_state, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS order_count FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN sellers s ON s.seller_id = oi.seller_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') GROUP BY oi.seller_id, s.seller_city, s.seller_state ORDER BY order_count DESC LIMIT 10

records.question: What percentage of orders were delivered?
records.sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_status = 'delivered') / COUNT(*), 2) AS delivered_percentage FROM orders

records.question: How many delivered orders arrived later than their estimated delivery date?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS late_delivered_orders FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered' AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL AND order_delivered_customer_date > order_estimated_delivery_date

records.question: What is the average number of days between purchase and delivery for delivered orders?
records.sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (order_delivered_customer_date - order_purchase_timestamp)) / 86400)::numeric, 2) AS avg_days_to_delivery FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered' AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL AND order_purchase_timestamp IS NOT NULL

records.question: What is the average review score for orders that include a health_beauty product?
records.sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(r.review_score), 2) AS average_review_score FROM order_reviews r WHERE r.order_id IN (SELECT oi.order_id FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN product_category_name_translation t ON t.product_category_name = p.product_category_name WHERE t.product_category_name_english = 'health_beauty')

records.question: How much money was paid with each payment type?
records.sql: SELECT payment_type, SUM(payment_value) AS total_paid FROM order_payments GROUP BY payment_type ORDER BY total_paid DESC

records.question: Which 5 customer states placed the most orders?
records.sql: SELECT c.customer_state AS customer_state, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_state ORDER BY order_count DESC LIMIT 5

records.question: What was the revenue in each month of 2018?
records.sql: SELECT date_trunc('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS month, SUM(oi.price) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2019-01-01' AND o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

records.question: How many items does an order contain on average?
records.sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(item_count), 2) AS avg_items_per_order FROM (SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) AS item_count FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id) AS per_order

records.question: How many orders were paid using more than one payment type?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS multi_payment_type_orders FROM (SELECT order_id FROM order_payments GROUP BY order_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT payment_type) > 1) AS multi_type_orders

records.question: Which state has the most sellers, and how many does it have?
records.sql: SELECT seller_state, COUNT(*) AS seller_count FROM sellers GROUP BY seller_state ORDER BY seller_count DESC LIMIT 1

records.question: How many orders were placed in November 2017?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-11-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2017-12-01'

records.question: What was the total revenue from delivered orders placed in 2017?
records.sql: SELECT SUM(oi.price) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-01-01'

records.question: What is the average shipping (freight) cost per order?
records.sql: WITH order_freight AS (SELECT oi.order_id, SUM(oi.freight_value) AS order_shipping FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') GROUP BY oi.order_id) SELECT ROUND(AVG(order_shipping), 2) AS avg_shipping_cost_per_order FROM order_freight

records.question: How many products have been sold exactly once?
records.sql: WITH product_sales AS (SELECT oi.product_id, COUNT(*) AS times_sold FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') GROUP BY oi.product_id) SELECT COUNT(*) AS products_sold_exactly_once FROM product_sales WHERE times_sold = 1

records.question: How many orders have a review with a written comment?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS orders_with_comment FROM order_reviews WHERE review_comment_message IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(review_comment_message) <> ''

records.question: How many sellers have sold more than 100 items?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS seller_count FROM (SELECT oi.seller_id FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') GROUP BY oi.seller_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 100) AS big_sellers

records.question: Which 3 product categories contain the most products?
records.sql: SELECT COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS category, COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM products p LEFT JOIN product_category_name_translation t ON t.product_category_name = p.product_category_name WHERE p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY product_count DESC LIMIT 3

records.question: How many delivered orders arrived in under 7 days after purchase?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS delivered_under_7_days FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered' AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL AND order_delivered_customer_date - order_purchase_timestamp < INTERVAL '7 days'

records.question: How many customers have placed more than one order?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS repeat_customer_count FROM (SELECT c.customer_unique_id FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id HAVING COUNT(o.order_id) > 1) AS repeat_customers

records.question: What percentage of customers have placed more than one order?
records.sql: WITH per_customer AS (SELECT c.customer_unique_id, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id) SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_count > 1) / COUNT(*), 2) AS pct_repeat_customers FROM per_customer

records.question: For each month from February to December 2017, what was the percentage revenue growth compared with the previous month?
records.sql: WITH monthly AS (SELECT date_trunc('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS month_start, SUM(oi.price) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') GROUP BY 1), with_prev AS (SELECT month_start, revenue, LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month_start) AS prev_revenue FROM monthly) SELECT month_start, ROUND(revenue, 2) AS total_revenue, ROUND(100.0 * (revenue - prev_revenue) / prev_revenue, 2) AS growth_pct FROM with_prev WHERE month_start >= '2017-02-01' AND month_start < '2018-01-01' ORDER BY month_start

records.question: What were the top 3 product categories by revenue in each year?
records.sql: WITH rev AS (SELECT date_trunc('year', o.order_purchase_timestamp)::date AS order_year, COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS category, SUM(oi.price) AS total_revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id LEFT JOIN product_category_name_translation t ON t.product_category_name = p.product_category_name WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') GROUP BY 1, 2), ranked AS (SELECT order_year, category, total_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY order_year ORDER BY total_revenue DESC) AS rank_in_year FROM rev) SELECT order_year, category, total_revenue, rank_in_year FROM ranked WHERE rank_in_year <= 3 ORDER BY order_year, rank_in_year

records.question: What percentage of total revenue comes from the top 10 sellers?
records.sql: WITH valid_items AS (SELECT oi.seller_id, oi.price FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')), seller_rev AS (SELECT seller_id, SUM(price) AS revenue FROM valid_items GROUP BY seller_id), top10 AS (SELECT revenue FROM seller_rev ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT ROUND(100.0 * (SELECT SUM(revenue) FROM top10) / (SELECT SUM(price) FROM valid_items), 2) AS top10_revenue_share_pct

records.question: By how many points is the average review score lower for late deliveries than for on-time deliveries (delivered orders only)?
records.sql: WITH d AS (SELECT o.order_id, (o.order_delivered_customer_date > o.order_estimated_delivery_date) AS is_late FROM orders o WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL AND o.order_estimated_delivery_date IS NOT NULL) SELECT ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN d.is_late THEN r.review_score END), 2) AS late_avg_score, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN NOT d.is_late THEN r.review_score END), 2) AS on_time_avg_score, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN NOT d.is_late THEN r.review_score END) - AVG(CASE WHEN d.is_late THEN r.review_score END), 2) AS score_gap_points FROM d JOIN order_reviews r ON r.order_id = d.order_id

records.question: Across all categories, which one has the highest average freight cost per item, and what is it?
records.sql: SELECT COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS category, ROUND(AVG(oi.freight_value), 2) AS avg_freight_per_item, COUNT(*) AS item_count FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id LEFT JOIN product_category_name_translation t ON t.product_category_name = p.product_category_name WHERE p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY avg_freight_per_item DESC LIMIT 1

records.question: How many orders contained items from more than one seller?

records.question: What is the average order value, including shipping, for delivered orders?

records.question: What was the average delivery time in days for delivered orders, for each purchase year?
records.sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_purchase_timestamp)::int AS purchase_year, ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (order_delivered_customer_date - order_purchase_timestamp)) / 86400.0), 2) AS avg_delivery_days FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered' AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

records.question: How many sellers earned more revenue than the average seller?
records.sql: WITH seller_rev AS (SELECT oi.seller_id, SUM(oi.price) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') GROUP BY oi.seller_id) SELECT COUNT(*) AS seller_count FROM seller_rev WHERE revenue > (SELECT AVG(revenue) FROM seller_rev)

records.question: Which 5 customer states have the highest average order value (item prices only)?
records.sql: WITH order_totals AS (SELECT o.order_id, c.customer_state, SUM(oi.price) AS order_value FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') GROUP BY o.order_id, c.customer_state) SELECT customer_state, ROUND(AVG(order_value), 2) AS avg_order_value, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM order_totals GROUP BY customer_state ORDER BY avg_order_value DESC LIMIT 5

records.question: What is the median order value (item prices only)?
